title: HR Analytics Dashboard
subtitle: Build an executive people-health dashboard from raw HR metrics in under 30 minutes.
ai_tool: Any AI tool (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, Gemini)

data_files.display_name: Genpact APAC HR Metrics — Q4 FY2024
data_files.role: Genpact APAC BU — 2,847 headcount, 7 departments, 16.3% attrition (benchmark 13.5%), hiring pipeline, engagement scores (68 vs 72 benchmark), $12.8M attrition cost

learning_objectives: Attach an HR metrics file and let the AI read every percentage and cost figure — your job is risk interpretation, not data lookup
Write the five things a spreadsheet cannot tell an AI: who is in the ExCo room, what the data story is, which department is the burning platform, what action is required, and which KPI is the hero
Specify RAG thresholds, benchmark comparisons, and an alert callout in the prompt so your first build already surfaces the risk signal — not buried in a table
Iterate with precision: name the single most important gap in your first output and fix only that in one follow-up
Deliver a board-ready HR dashboard a CHRO can present at an offsite without Excel — single HTML file, no server, no dependencies
deliverable: Single-file interactive HTML HR analytics dashboard
